items.title: Joe Wilder Part 2 interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 12, 1998
items.q: as in the case of the jazz party you have here at Hamilton, especially with people like Milt Fillius

ctx.x: How is the actual business — it seems that there are too many stories about business people taking advantage of musicians over the years. Have you experienced that and has it changed?

Well I think it’s changed and for instance, as in the case of the jazz party you have here at Hamilton, especially with people like Milt Fillius. I mean these are men who are proud of who they are and they want people who work for them to feel proud of having been associated with him. I’m using him as an example. There are a few others, there aren’t many, but there are some others who think likewise. And they treat the musicians very well, with a great deal of respect, and of course they expect the same in…
